decisions.decision: Pin Chromium --force-device-scale-factor=1 and size CSS to 1024x600 natively
decisions.rationale: Waveshare 7" reports 168 DPI via EDID, causing Chromium to auto-scale. Brain note flagged 'don't just hack DPI' but doing it alongside tuned CSS is the correct fixed-kiosk setup, not masking.

decisions.decision: Switch offline tiles from CartoDB dark_all to MapTiler openstreetmap raster
decisions.rationale: CartoDB dark_all is minimalist/decorative — too sparse for navigation. Tested three options (dark_all, Voyager, OSM classic); user preferred OSM classic detail. MapTiler provides OSM classic raster with paid/free tier + fast rate limits.

decisions.decision: Reverse SSE seed order server-side rather than changing frontend unshift behaviour
decisions.rationale: Minimal change (one line). Frontend unshift works correctly for live events; only the seed-then-pop cycle was buggy. Reversing seed at yield time preserves live-event behaviour.

decisions.decision: Defer lux-based auto day/night tile toggle
decisions.rationale: User confirmed day-only driving. OSM classic light tiles readable in daylight without auto-switching. Lux plumbing (snapshot + sse + frontend) is small but not needed for stated use case.
